adds.rationale: Constellation's landmark 20-year, 835MW Microsoft PPA to restart Three Mile Island Unit 1 is the clearest buildup-phase confirmation yet of the nuclear/SMR-to-AI-datacenter thesis, and the market reaction (stock +22% same day) shows it is not yet fully priced.

news_evidence.summary: Constellation signs 20-year, 835MW PPA with Microsoft to restart Three Mile Island Unit 1 (Crane Clean Energy Center), the first-ever US nuclear plant restart after shutdown
CEG shares surge ~22% on the Sep 20 Microsoft deal; KeyBanc raises target $230->$265

removes.rationale: The tanker/geopolitical thesis is softening in real time (weak cargo demand, no rate momentum into seasonal Q3 lows), and at cap=4 the capital is better redeployed into the newly-confirmed nuclear buildup signal.

news_evidence.summary: On its Q2 2024 call, Scorpio Tankers management flags entry into the seasonally weak Q3 period
Week-37 tanker monitor shows VLCC cargo demand well below benchmark and Worldscale rates failing to firm

rationale_overall: A one-for-one swap keeping the watchlist at cap 4: MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA remain the AI core (all strong in-window — MSFT FY24Q4 +15% revenue with Azure +29% Jul 30; NVDA FQ2 +122% YoY with strong Blackwell demand; GOOGL's Aug 5 search-antitrust ruling a flagged risk but not yet a breach); STNG exits as its tanker thesis cools into a soft Q3 with no fresh catalyst; CEG enters as the sharpest buildup signal for the profile's nuclear next-wave (the Sep 20 Microsoft-TMI PPA and 22% pop). Shape shifts from 3 AI + 1 tanker to 3 AI + 1 nuclear.
